findings.evidence: dom-1440 lists nine visible h2 elements (y 1982, 2883, 4505, 6017 …) whose text content is empty, although tiles show headings like 'Finding a time took a week of emails. Now it's one link.' The words appear to be drawn by animated spans outside the heading's text, so the heading outline may be empty to assistive tech.
findings.before: <h2> with animated word spans (empty text at capture)
findings.after: Keep the full sentence as real text inside each h2 and animate presentational copies marked aria-hidden
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.6 Headings and Labels. Not verified with a screen reader; flagged from the DOM.

findings.evidence: Integration hub icons (Google Calendar, Outlook, Zoom, HubSpot, Slack, Zapier) render with alt="" and no adjacent text in the hub graphic (tile 05); names only appear later in the list below.
findings.before: Decorative-marked icons carrying the only label in the hub
findings.after: Give the hub a figure caption naming the apps, or alt="Google Calendar" etc. on each icon
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: icons that carry meaning need a text alternative.
